patched.notes: PAT-662: mirror_eula_approved=true — artifact size was previously hitting the 400 MB cap; cap raised to 2 GB. Docker Desktop DMG is ~600 MB. Docker Desktop is free for small teams/personal use; redistribution of the installer for enterprise update management is permitted under Docker's Terms. PAT-719: cross_hash_sources added using Docker's static checksums.txt endpoint. PAT-719: vendor_only=true — trust-posture decision. Docker.app is genuinely notarized (spctl: accepted, source=Notarized Developer ID, Docker Inc 9BNSXJN65R) but the vendor does NOT staple the notarization ticket, so xcrun stapler validate exits 65. The pipeline's strict stapled-only gate therefore false-negatives this legitimately-notarized-but-unstapled artifact. Rather than weaken the gate with an spctl fallback (needs syspolicyd + network on the GHA runner; Gatekeeper-quirky), Docker installs come from the vendor URL only — same posture as vmwarefusion. Revisit if Docker begins stapling, or if a mirror-side spctl proof-run is greenlit.
